name: Mall interior frame
summary: A photo of an empty shopping mall, faded to look like a picture from the 1980s or 1990s, set as the one focal image beside a pale tiled ground.
how: Use one photo of a mall hall or lobby as the focal image and show no people.
Lower the contrast by 10% to 20% and warm the shadows, so that the photo looks old.
Set the photo off centre on a pale tiled ground with at least 40% empty space.

origin.note: The year follows the first release that the Mallsoft article names; the article says the visuals pair tracks with 1980s and 1990s mall images, but it gives no date for the first picture.

adoptions.via: Video uploads of mallsoft tracks show images of malls that look like they date from the 1980s and 1990s.
